scope: One in-memory Shard, 45-second scheduled playerbots travel fixture with navigation; no Gateway or connected client. Test assertions remain unchanged.
concurrency: Owned compilation and integration tests completed before measurement. Existing live Realm and unrelated processes remained running.
measurement: Three fresh-process samples per size and implementation. Each fixture keeps scheduled navigation and Package decisions active for 45 seconds. Execution order alternates between samples. Setup is excluded from runtime CPU; there is no warmup exclusion within each measured sample.
interpretation: CPU is total observed runtime CPU divided by total observed window duration. Decision p95 ranges describe the three individual samples, not a pooled percentile. Sizes with failed samples are overload observations, not passing capacity results. This fixture has no Gateway or connected clients and does not establish connected-player capacity.
